title: WHO EVALUATES AI’S SOCIAL IMPACTS? MAPPING COVERAGE AND GAPS IN FIRST AND THIRD PARTY EVALUATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review and annotation (using a 0-3 scoring scheme) of first-party and third-party release reports to evaluate the presence, detail, and reproducibility of reported bias and stereotype evaluations.

Systematic review and annotation of model documentation and post-release reports to assess how thoroughly developers and third parties report on unequal model outcomes or performance disparities across different subpopulations, languages, or accents.
Evaluating model cards, technical reports, and leaderboards on a 0-3 scale for their reporting and methodological transparency regarding sensitive content, toxicity, and cultural biases.
